portfolioPage.title: Built for Businesses Around the World
portfolioPage.description: A selection of projects and concept builds spanning ERP, e-commerce, AI and infrastructure. Concept and demo work is clearly labeled.

again-erp-concept.summary: A concept ERP system exploring how AI-assisted forecasting and unified operations could work for a mid-size manufacturer.
again-erp-concept.challenge: Manufacturers often run finance, inventory and production on disconnected spreadsheets and legacy tools, leading to slow decisions and stock mismatches.
again-erp-concept.solution: Designed a unified ERP data model covering dashboard, HRM, sales, inventory and accounting, with an AI layer surfacing demand forecasts and stock anomalies.
again-erp-concept.outcome: A working concept demonstrating how AI-assisted planning can reduce manual reporting effort and highlight operational risk earlier.

againcart-ecommerce.summary: A demo commerce platform built to explore high-volume catalog management and checkout performance patterns.
againcart-ecommerce.challenge: High-SKU retail catalogs need fast filtering, accurate inventory sync and a checkout flow that holds up under traffic spikes.
againcart-ecommerce.solution: Built a demo storefront with server-rendered catalog pages, optimized checkout and a synchronized inventory layer.
againcart-ecommerce.outcome: Established reusable commerce architecture patterns for catalog performance and checkout reliability.

harborcloud-infrastructure-demo.summary: An internal reference architecture for scalable, secure cloud deployment and CI/CD pipelines.
harborcloud-infrastructure-demo.challenge: Growing teams need infrastructure that scales safely without manual deployment risk or inconsistent environments.
harborcloud-infrastructure-demo.solution: Designed an infrastructure-as-code reference stack with automated CI/CD, monitoring and hardened access control.
harborcloud-infrastructure-demo.outcome: A reusable infrastructure blueprint for reliable, auditable deployments across environments.

meridian-corporate-concept.summary: A concept corporate web platform exploring modern content architecture for professional services firms.
meridian-corporate-concept.challenge: Professional services firms need credible, fast, content-rich websites that are easy to maintain without a heavy CMS.
meridian-corporate-concept.solution: Designed a component-driven, data-driven corporate site architecture ready for lightweight CMS integration.
meridian-corporate-concept.outcome: A flexible corporate site pattern that balances editorial flexibility with front-end performance.

vantage-ai-advisor-concept.summary: A concept AI advisory assistant exploring how conversational AI could guide business users toward the right internal workflows.
vantage-ai-advisor-concept.challenge: Business users often don't know which internal tool or workflow applies to a task, creating friction and support overhead.
vantage-ai-advisor-concept.solution: Prototyped a server-side AI advisor that interprets natural-language requests and routes users to the right workflow or resource.
vantage-ai-advisor-concept.outcome: Validated an architecture pattern for keeping AI API keys server-side while delivering a responsive advisory experience.

growthline-marketing-demo.summary: An internal demo exploring a unified reporting layer across SEO, ads and conversion analytics for an online retailer.
growthline-marketing-demo.challenge: Growth teams often track SEO, paid ads and conversion data in separate dashboards, making funnel-wide decisions slow.
growthline-marketing-demo.solution: Built a demo reporting layer consolidating organic, paid and on-site conversion signals into one funnel view.
growthline-marketing-demo.outcome: Demonstrated a practical pattern for connecting acquisition and conversion data for faster growth decisions.

privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy

overview.heading: Overview
body: This Privacy Policy explains how RankVibez ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects information when you visit rankvibez.com or engage with our services.

informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
body: When you submit our contact form, we collect the information you provide, such as your name, company, email address, phone number and project details.
We may also collect standard technical information such as browser type and general usage data to help us improve the website.

howWeUseInformation.heading: How We Use Information
body: Information submitted through our contact form is used solely to respond to your inquiry and, where relevant, to prepare a project proposal.
We do not sell or rent personal information to third parties.

dataRetention.heading: Data Retention
body: We retain inquiry information for as long as necessary to respond to your request and maintain business records, after which it may be deleted.

contact.heading: Contact

whoWeWorkWith.q: What kind of businesses does RankVibez work with?
whoWeWorkWith.a: We work with businesses that need enterprise-grade software, infrastructure, security or growth systems — from growing companies to larger organizations across retail, manufacturing, finance, healthcare, technology and other industries.

pricing.a: Most engagements are scoped individually through a discovery call and custom proposal. Where indicative pricing is shown, it is listed in USD as a starting point rather than a fixed final cost.

process.q: What does the engagement process look like?
process.a: We follow a structured process: discover, strategize, design, build, secure, launch and grow — with clear checkpoints and documentation at each stage.

ongoingSupport.q: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
ongoingSupport.a: Yes. Monitoring, maintenance and continuous improvement are available as part of a managed technology services engagement.

aiIntegration.q: Can RankVibez integrate AI into an existing system?
aiIntegration.a: Yes. We regularly assess existing workflows and add AI capabilities — automation, analytics or agents — into systems that are already in production.

location.a: RankVibez operates from Dhaka, Bangladesh, and serves clients across multiple international markets.

serviceDetailPage.pricingDescription: Every engagement is scoped to the business. For enterprise services, we prefer a custom proposal over fixed pricing.

hosting.name: Hosting
hosting.short: Linux, Windows and BDIX web hosting with cPanel, ASP .NET and MVC support.
hosting.description: Shared and reseller web hosting built on SSD storage and monitored infrastructure — whether your site runs on WordPress, Laravel, ASP .NET or a custom MVC stack. BDIX-connected plans keep Bangladeshi visitors on local routing for noticeably faster page loads.

domain.name: Domain
domain.short: Register, renew, transfer and resell domains across every major extension.
domain.description: Secure the names your brand depends on. We handle registration, renewal and transfers for gTLDs, ccTLDs and .com.bd domains, with free DNS management, theft protection and bulk tooling for portfolios of any size.

email.name: Email
email.short: Business email hosting on your own domain, including BDIX and Google Workspace.
email.description: Professional mailboxes on your own domain with spam filtering, mobile sync and generous storage. Choose BDIX-hosted email for local speed, our standard business platform, or a fully managed Google Workspace deployment.

ssl.name: SSL
ssl.short: SSL certificates, wildcard validation, free SSL and hands-on installation.
ssl.description: Encrypt every connection to your site and clear the browser warnings that cost you conversions. From free DV certificates to organisation-validated and wildcard options, we source, validate and install the right certificate for you.

vps-server.name: VPS Server
vps-server.short: Managed and self-managed KVM VPS on Linux and Windows, including BDIX.
vps-server.description: Dedicated CPU, RAM and NVMe storage on virtualised hardware, with full root or administrator access. Pick a self-managed instance if your team runs the stack, or a managed plan where we handle patching, backups and monitoring.

dedicated-servers.name: Dedicated Server
dedicated-servers.short: Bare-metal servers in Bangladesh and the USA, managed or unmanaged.
dedicated-servers.description: An entire physical machine reserved for your workload — no noisy neighbours, no shared resources. Deploy in Bangladesh for local latency or in the USA for global reach, with storage, maintenance and management options on top.

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.short: Cloud hosting, storage, private cloud and infrastructure as a service.
cloud.description: Elastic infrastructure that grows with demand instead of forcing you to buy for peak. Cloud hosting, object and FTP storage, private clouds on Windows or Linux, backup, disaster recovery and hybrid architectures.

ip-pbx.name: IP PBX
ip-pbx.short: Dedicated and cloud IP PBX systems with IP numbers for business calling.
ip-pbx.description: Run your entire phone system over the internet. Extensions, IVR menus, call recording, queues and reporting — hosted in the cloud or on a dedicated PBX in your own environment, with IP numbers for inbound and outbound calling.

bulk-sms.name: Bulk SMS
bulk-sms.short: Bulk and masking SMS delivery with brand sender IDs and an API.
bulk-sms.description: Reach customers where they always look. Send transactional alerts, OTPs and campaigns to every operator in Bangladesh, with masking SMS so messages arrive under your brand name instead of a numeric sender.

enterprise-software.name: Enterprise Software
enterprise-software.short: Custom ERP, AI-driven ERP, e-commerce platforms and web applications.
enterprise-software.description: Software built around how your business actually works — ERP for finance, HR and inventory, commerce platforms that scale, and web applications designed, built and maintained by one team.

security.name: Cyber Security
security.short: Security assessment, hardening and monitoring for your infrastructure.
security.description: Protect your systems, data and customers with layered defence — vulnerability assessment, hardening, monitoring and incident response across your applications, servers and networks.

digital-growth.name: Digital Growth
digital-growth.short: SEO, digital marketing, paid campaigns and conversion optimisation.
digital-growth.description: Turn traffic into revenue. Search visibility, paid acquisition, campaign management and conversion work that is measured against pipeline, not vanity metrics.

ai-business-transformation.name: AI & Business Transformation
ai-business-transformation.short: AI automation, AI-driven operations and virtual assistance.
ai-business-transformation.description: Put AI to work inside your operations — automating repetitive workflows, surfacing decisions from your own data, and extending your team with trained virtual assistance.

erp.short: Custom ERP systems for finance, HR, inventory, sales and operations.
erp.description: We design and build enterprise resource planning systems tailored to how your business actually operates — connecting finance, HR, inventory, sales, purchasing and manufacturing into a single source of truth.

ai-erp.name: AI-Driven ERP
ai-erp.short: ERP systems enhanced with AI agents, automation and intelligent analytics.
ai-erp.description: We extend traditional ERP with AI agents, predictive analytics and automation — helping teams forecast demand, flag anomalies and reduce manual data entry across every department.

ecommerce.name: E-Commerce Solutions
ecommerce.short: Custom e-commerce platforms, marketplaces and order management.
ecommerce.description: We build high-performance e-commerce platforms and marketplaces — from product catalogs and checkout to order management, payments and logistics integrations.

web-development.name: Web Development
web-development.short: Corporate websites, business portals and enterprise web applications.
web-development.description: We design and engineer corporate websites, client portals and web applications built on modern, scalable architecture — fast, accessible and SEO-ready from day one.

server-maintenance.name: Server Maintenance
server-maintenance.short: Linux/Windows server management, monitoring and security.
server-maintenance.description: We manage and maintain Linux and Windows server environments — monitoring uptime, applying security patches, optimizing performance and handling backups so your infrastructure stays reliable.

cloud-infrastructure.name: Cloud Infrastructure
cloud-infrastructure.short: Cloud deployment, migration, scaling and architecture.
cloud-infrastructure.description: We architect and manage cloud infrastructure across leading providers — designing systems that scale reliably, deploy safely and stay observable in production.

business-email.name: Professional Email Service
business-email.short: Business email setup, migration, security and administration.
business-email.description: We set up and administer professional business email — configuring DNS, SPF, DKIM and DMARC correctly, migrating mailboxes safely and hardening deliverability and security.

iaas-vm.name: IaaS Virtual Machines
iaas-vm.short: Custom cloud virtual machines with configurable vCPU, RAM, storage and bandwidth.
iaas-vm.description: We provision Infrastructure-as-a-Service virtual machines built around your exact workload — configurable vCPU, RAM, storage, IP allocation and bandwidth, billed monthly or as a reserved plan for predictable long-term workloads.

backup-as-a-service.name: Backup as a Service
backup-as-a-service.short: Protected offsite storage with scheduled backup jobs and restore support.
backup-as-a-service.description: We run Backup-as-a-Service for servers, databases and applications — protected storage, scheduled backup jobs and tested restore support, billed per protected GB/TB so cost scales with what you actually store.

object-storage.name: Object Storage
object-storage.short: S3-compatible object storage for media, backups and application data.
object-storage.description: We provide S3-compatible object storage built on Ceph RGW — durable, scalable storage for media libraries, backups and application data, accessible through standard S3 APIs and billed per GB stored.

dr-as-a-service.name: Disaster Recovery as a Service
dr-as-a-service.short: Replication, recovery planning and tested failover for business continuity.
dr-as-a-service.description: We design and operate Disaster-Recovery-as-a-Service — replicating critical systems, building a documented recovery plan and running regular test exercises so failover works when it actually matters, not just on paper.
